translation_notes: prefixes narrowed to rdf/agento/agentoscin: OWL/RDFS/XSD from the draft are unused by the region's own body (noise, as noted for prior trav_navigation regions in this batch).

the region does NOT fuse into one multi-pattern m{ }: the six `self.g.objects(step_uri, PRED)` calls (nextStep, hasDecoratorArgument, hasAssociatedAgent, plus the three `in self.g` existence checks) each read a DIFFERENT predicate off the same step_uri to fill independent fields (next_names, decorator_args, associated_agent_key, is_start/is_conditional/is_end) -- joining them would be a Cartesian product across unrelated predicates, not the intersection the original code computes. Each site gets its own most-specific island instead: `m{ {step_uri} pred ?var }` replacing each `.objects()` call (trav_one_step, arity 1), and `bool(m{ {step_uri} rdf:type TYPE })` replacing each `(s, p, o) in g` (trav_existence). The outer `for step_uri in m{ {wp_uri} agento:hasWorkflowStep ?step_uri }` is the one genuine navigation step.

self._str_value / self._int_value / self._local_name / self._agent_uri_to_key are plain method/dict lookups external to the region (defined on OntologyReader, reconstructed minimally in shim.py) and are left untouched -- only the region's own direct rdflib calls are translated.

context shim (shim.py) also stands in for `from oscin.namespaces import (...)`, unavailable outside the source repository: original.py's import line was changed from `oscin.namespaces` to `shim` (permitted -- restoring the missing binding, see AGENT_BATCH.md); the constants/Namespace objects themselves are otherwise identical.

fixture.ttl gives wp:WP1 one step of each observable step_type (conditional-not-start, start, end, regular) so every branch and every optional field (routing_logic, edge_mapping, decorator_args, associated_agent_key, calls_crew) is exercised, including the zero-solution case (step:Regular has none of the optional predicates) and a neighbouring workflow (wp:WP2/step:Foreign) that must not be read.

repair.driver: Après run_pair sur fixture.ttl, le pilote ré-exécute chaque artefact sur 9 graphes de cas en ne changeant que la ligne de contexte `self, wp_uri = build_fixture()` (-> un shim._Reader frais sur le graphe du cas, wp_uri URIRef comme dans le dépôt, reader.py:671) et compare step_info, step_uri_to_name et stdout : deux agents à clé dans les deux ordres d'insertion (le break), agent inconnu et clé "" avant un agent à clé, agent à clé sur une autre étape, combinaisons de types (start+conditional, end+conditional, start+end), tous les champs portés par des prédicats voisins, valeurs multiples (nextStep, arguments dont une IRI et un littéral à langue), workflow sans étape à côté d'un autre qui en a, graphe vide.
repair.remaining: L'équivalence du break repose sur l'ordre d'insertion commun à g.objects() et m{ } sur le store Memory (dit dans la docstring) ; le populator du dépôt ne lie qu'un agent par étape (populator.py:913-920).

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the step_info values that were computed into one-use temporaries (order, routing_logic, next_names, decorator_args, associated_agent_key, aggregation_combinator, calls_crew) are written in the dict literal: two comprehensions replace the append loops, `next(filter(None, ...), None)` replaces the first-truthy-key loop with its break (lazy, so it stops at the same agent), and routing_logic becomes a conditional expression. is_end is inlined in its elif. The edge-mapping block becomes `try: json.loads(... or "{}") except (JSONDecodeError, TypeError): {}`, the same value in every case. step_info is now written before step_uri_to_name, so a raise while building the dict (only _int_value can raise) leaves both dicts as the original leaves them. The module-level leftovers that disappear (order, next_names, lit, key, edge_mapping_json...) are not compared; the ones kept (name, is_start, is_conditional, step_type, edge_mapping) keep their values.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: the six reads become islands under the harness's `@graph self.g`: `m{ {wp_uri} agento:hasWorkflowStep ?step_uri }`, `bool(m{ {step_uri} a agento:StartStep })` and its ConditionalStep twin (bool kept: is_start/is_conditional are compared module values), `m{ {step_uri} a agento:EndStep }` bare in the elif, and three `m{ {step_uri} P ?v }` in the comprehensions; each is two to five tokens shorter than its Python (measured). The _str_value/_int_value arguments become prefixed names.
No exception to the symmetry; no join (each read fills an independent field).
header_optimization_notes: Python: Optional (the annotation went with the loop), Graph, Namespace, URIRef, OWL, RDFS, XSD, COORD_CUSTOM, COORD_SEQUENTIAL and HAS_DESCRIPTION go; RDF is imported from rdflib with Literal; the shim import fits on one line.
LD Python: the same, plus RDF, AGENTO and AGENTOSCIN (replaced by the prefixes); @prefix rdf: goes (rdf:type is written `a`).
